mapper.select: SELECT '处方' AS item_type, p.id AS item_id, d.drug_name AS item_name, COALESCE(p.unit_price, d.drug_price) AS unit_price, p.drug_number AS quantity FROM prescription p JOIN drug_info d ON p.drug_id = d.id WHERE p.register_id = #{registerId} AND p.drug_state = '1' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fee_record f WHERE f.item_type = '处方' AND f.item_id = p.id AND f.fee_type = '收费' )

SELECT '检查' AS item_type, c.id AS item_id, m.tech_name AS item_name, m.tech_price AS unit_price FROM check_request c JOIN medical_technology m ON c.medical_technology_id = m.id WHERE c.register_id = #{registerId} AND c.check_state = '1' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fee_record f WHERE f.item_type = '检查' AND f.item_id = c.id AND f.fee_type = '收费' )

SELECT '检验' AS item_type, i.id AS item_id, m.tech_name AS item_name, m.tech_price AS unit_price FROM inspection_request i JOIN medical_technology m ON i.medical_technology_id = m.id WHERE i.register_id = #{registerId} AND i.inspection_state = '1' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fee_record f WHERE f.item_type = '检验' AND f.item_id = i.id AND f.fee_type = '收费' )

SELECT '处置' AS item_type, d.id AS item_id, m.tech_name AS item_name, m.tech_price AS unit_price FROM disposal_request d JOIN medical_technology m ON d.medical_technology_id = m.id WHERE d.register_id = #{registerId} AND d.disposal_state = '1' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fee_record f WHERE f.item_type = '处置' AND f.item_id = d.id AND f.fee_type = '收费' )
